implementation_notes: A `shared-kernel` Maven module both contexts depend on, containing the shared domain types and nothing else. Publish it as its own artifact so it can be upgraded atomically; run a single CI job that builds and tests both consumers against one kernel version.
idiom_name: separate Maven artifact + one CI job for both consumers
code_sketch:
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.acme</groupId><artifactId>shared-kernel</artifactId><version>1.4.0</version>
</dependency>
<!-- shared-kernel must not depend on billing or orders -->
pitfalls: Kernel depending on Spring Boot starters so it drags the whole framework in
Both contexts pinning different kernel versions
